style_rules: Create exactly one premium vertical 3:4 Vietnamese corporate HR attendance infographic using ChatGPT Image.
ABSOLUTELY NO LOGO, no company-name mark, no tagline and no slogan.
Use fresh bright green as the primary positive accent with deep navy, professional blue, restrained gold, white/light-blue surfaces, and red only for missing/error states.
Use a bright modern office atmosphere with natural daylight, glass-office depth, green plants and refined business desk elements to create visual energy and professionalism.
Keep office imagery secondary to the data; use premium rounded cards, layered depth, subtle shadows and strong hierarchy.
Fixed information order: title/date/update time; 4 KPI cards; confirmed-hours strip; chart plus overview; exact 8-row detail table; reconciliation footer.
All employee names, dates, times, durations, statuses, KPIs and session strings must come only from the validated report.
Never infer, recalculate, paraphrase or fabricate attendance values inside the generated image.
Missing values display exactly as an em dash.
Show all 8 employees exactly once in the validated order.
After image generation, visually QA all KPIs and all 8 rows against the handoff; regenerate/edit with ChatGPT Image if any mismatch is found.
Do not publish an image that fails exact-data QA.
